data.long_meaning: In Latin, the name Raymunda means 'recommender of the mountain'. This name is derived from the Latin word 'recommendare', meaning 'to recommend', and 'montana', meaning 'mountain'. In Christian tradition, Raymunda is the name of a saint, believed to have lived in the 9th century. She was a noblewoman who dedicated her life to God and lived as a hermit in the mountains.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek solace and guidance from the mountains, symbolizing strength, stability, and a connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Raymunda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Recommender of the mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raymunda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Ραιμούνδα
in_greek.meaning: όνομα γυναικός με καλές και δυνατές ιδιότητες

in_latin.name: Raymunda
in_latin.meaning: nomen femininum cum virtutibus bonis et fortibus
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen femininum quod virtutes habet bonas sicut- misericordia, largitas, caritas, et Pax. Origine nomen a nomine Ben-Ami, quod significat homo misericordia, largus, pater, et in cultura Hebraica antiqua significat, qui erat homo qui erat miser, qui erat largus, qui erat pater.

in_english.meaning: a feminine given name with good and strong qualities
